title: Border Patrol Class 1374 marks milestone in Laredo Sector before taking oath of office
excerpt: Future Border Patrol agents in U.S. Border Patrol Class 1374 gathered in the Laredo Sector for guidance from command staff before taking their oath of office, the agency said Monday.
content:
Future U.S. Border Patrol agents in Class 1374 reached a milestone in the Laredo Sector before taking their solemn oath of office, the agency said Monday.

Before the oath, the future agents gathered to receive counsel from command staff, according to the U.S. Border Patrol Laredo Sector. The guidance covered navigating the academy — maintaining unwavering focus, dedicated study and steadfast discipline.

The agency congratulated Class 1374 as the future agents begin what it called an honorable journey of service and protection.

Source: U.S. Border Patrol Laredo Sector, November 9, 2026.
